Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely concluded that Sir Matt Busby was the manager who recruited David Beckham based on a dubious search snippet and did not verify the claim. This led to a misidentification of the manager and an internally inconsistent timeline (Busby did not manage Manchester United in the late 1980s). Proper cross-checking would have identified Sir Alex Ferguson as the recruiter, with the correct managerial timeframe (1986–2013).
